import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators

theorem intersection_is_unique_greatest_invariant_submodule {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F] [Module F V] {ι : Type*} (f : V →ₗ[F] V) (u : ι → Submodule F V) (hpres : ∀ i : ι, ∀ x : V, x ∈ u i → f x ∈ u i) : ∃! U : Submodule F V, (∀ x : V, x ∈ U ↔ ∀ i : ι, x ∈ u i) ∧ (∀ x : V, x ∈ U → f x ∈ U) ∧ (∀ W : Submodule F V, (∀ x : V, x ∈ W → f x ∈ W) → (∀ i : ι, W ≤ u i) → W ≤ U) := by
  let U₀ : Submodule F V := ⨅ i, u i
  have hU₀_mem : ∀ x : V, x ∈ U₀ ↔ ∀ i : ι, x ∈ u i := by
    intro x
    simp [U₀, Submodule.mem_iInf]
  have hU₀_inv : ∀ x : V, x ∈ U₀ → f x ∈ U₀ := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hU₀_mem] at hx ⊢
    intro i
    exact hpres i x (hx i)
  have hU₀_le : ∀ i : ι, U₀ ≤ u i := fun i => iInf_le u i
  have hU₀_greatest : ∀ W : Submodule F V, (∀ x : V, x ∈ W → f x ∈ W) → (∀ i : ι, W ≤ u i) → W ≤ U₀ := by
    intro W _ hWle
    exact le_iInf hWle
  refine ⟨U₀, ⟨hU₀_mem, hU₀_inv, hU₀_greatest⟩, ?_⟩
  intro U' hU'
  rcases hU' with ⟨hU'_mem, hU'_inv, hU'_greatest⟩
  have hU'_le : ∀ i : ι, U' ≤ u i := by
    intro i x hx
    have h := (hU'_mem x).mp hx
    exact h i
  have h_le1 : U' ≤ U₀ := hU₀_greatest U' hU'_inv hU'_le
  have h_le2 : U₀ ≤ U' := hU'_greatest U₀ hU₀_inv hU₀_le
  exact le_antisymm h_le1 h_le2
